dimensions.obligation_correctness: Recover document persistence, view retirement, reentrant handoff and transient preview semantics.
dimensions.evidence_grounding: Cite candidate-visible source and behavior documentation for each claimed relation.
dimensions.failure_prediction: Predict lost drafts, wrong-document writes, retired badges, overwritten navigation and preview publication.
dimensions.unsupported_claim_penalty: Do not require remote cancellation, asynchronous acknowledgements, a specific epoch variable or changing the preview delay without authorization.

obligations.statement: After a 120 ms quiet interval, each editor burst writes its latest text once; later bursts remain live.
obligations.event_relation: latest-edit precedes quiet-interval-expiry, which precedes one write
obligations.failure_if_violated: Per-keystroke writes retain the traffic problem; dropping work fails persistence.

obligations.statement: When close/open returns, the departed document retains its last accepted text under its own document key.
obligations.event_relation: departing-document pending commit precedes navigation return
obligations.failure_if_violated: Closing loses buffered text, changing target writes into another document, or the old timer duplicates a flushed commit.

obligations.statement: The departing save badge produces no output from the start of a close/open request; active saves can still update the active badge.
obligations.event_relation: view retirement precedes notifications generated by handoff
obligations.failure_if_violated: A retiring badge emits a saved status or all status output is suppressed.

obligations.statement: Navigation performed from a synchronous save integration takes precedence over the outer navigation.
obligations.event_relation: nested navigation supersedes outer handoff before the outer call returns
obligations.failure_if_violated: An outer open overwrites the document selected by a save callback; nested close is undone; new pending input is erased.

obligations.statement: Hiding transient preview work discards an unpublished query; reopening can schedule fresh work under the authorized delay.
obligations.event_relation: preview hide precedes discard and no later publication of that query
obligations.failure_if_violated: Changing shared cancel to flush publishes a query while hiding; global cancellation can also kill future work.

obligations.statement: A burst consumed during departure cannot commit again from its old timer.
obligations.event_relation: consume pending batch invalidates its old timer execution
obligations.failure_if_violated: The same draft is written twice after a close or switch.

obligations.statement: A new batch enqueued by a synchronous save callback remains eligible after the old callback returns.
obligations.event_relation: retire old batch precedes invoking callback that may enqueue new work
obligations.failure_if_violated: Cleanup after callback erases a newly queued edit.

obligations.statement: Keep the preview delay at 40 ms unless the granted suffix authorizes 120 ms; lifecycle policy remains discard-on-hide.
obligations.event_relation: last preview query precedes publication by the authorized quiet interval
obligations.failure_if_violated: A target-only edit also migrates adjacent preview timing without authorization.
required_concepts: timing authorization is separate from cancellation policy
